## Review and baseline

- [ ] Plans and standards followed, or an approved deviation is identified.
- [ ] Documentation and implementation claims agree.
- [ ] The reviewer did not author this change or its verification when independence is claimed.
- [ ] This change is not described as DO-178C compliant or certified without an approved project-specific certification basis.

### Risk and independence

<!-- State residual risk, exceptions, rollback considerations, and whether independent review is required. -->

- [ ] Traceability from objective to implementation and verification is documented.
- [ ] New behavior or a defect fix has regression evidence, or the exception is justified with an owner and review date.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, generated build output, or unrelated changes are included.
